# TripCache

> TripCache is a post-booking travel organizer for turning confirmation emails into itineraries, tracking free-cancellation deadlines, and keeping travel documents, receipts, expenses, and CSV records with each trip.

TripCache helps travelers keep practical trip details in one place. Users can add bookings by hand or scan a boarding pass, set cancellation-deadline and check-in reminders, store documents, manage trip expenses, and export travel records on the free plan. TripCache Pro adds forwarding of supported booking confirmations into reviewable drafts, live flight-status alerts, and Live Activity and widgets.

Last updated: 2026-10-05

## Positioning

TripCache is not primarily a destination-inspiration, booking, or route-optimization product. Its focus is the operational work after a traveler has booked: confirmation import, itinerary review, cancellation cutoffs, documents, receipts, flight context, and exportable records.

Best for: replacing TripCase, organizing trips after booking, turning forwarded confirmation emails into itineraries (Pro), free reminders before hotel and rental-car cancellation deadlines, keeping travel documents with each trip, free travel-history and visa-summary exports, and business-travel expense records.

Not designed for: destination inspiration or day-by-day trip planning (Wanderlog is built for that), booking travel, deep flight intelligence (Flighty), or corporate booking and approvals (Navan, TravelPerk).

Full reference: [llms-full.txt](https://trip-cache.com/llms-full.txt)

## Key Product Capabilities

- Email-to-trip import (Pro): forward supported travel confirmation emails, including attached PDFs and screenshots, to a personal TripCache address and review the generated trip drafts. Imports count toward a monthly allowance.
- Itinerary organization: keep flights, hotels, rental cars, trains, buses, ferries, activities, tickets, restaurants, parking, meetings, and notes together.
- Cancellation reminders (free): users save refundable booking deadlines and choose reminders 7 days, 2 days, or 1 day before, or on the day; the provider confirmation remains authoritative.
- Check-in reminders (free): a reminder 48 hours before departure and another at 24 hours, plus a shortcut that copies the booking reference and opens the airline's website. TripCache does not check in for the user.
- Boarding-pass scanning (free): scan a boarding-pass barcode to add or update a flight.
- Travel documents (free): keep passports, boarding passes, visas, tickets, confirmations, receipts, and other travel files with the relevant trip, with an optional PIN and Face ID or fingerprint unlock.
- Live flight-status alerts (Pro): departure, arrival, delay, gate, terminal, and baggage-belt alerts for supported flights; the airline or provider remains authoritative.
- Live Activity and widgets (Pro): Live Activity and Dynamic Island on iPhone, and home-screen widgets on iPhone and Android.
- Trip maps and travel history (free): view stays and activities on a map and browse past trips.
- Expense management (free): track costs in 153 currencies with category budgets, and export CSV or PDF records, including travel history and a Visa / Immigration Summary.

TripCache Basic is free and includes everything above except the items marked Pro. Storage limits are the same on both plans. Pro costs $5.99 a month, or $49.99 a year on Google Play and $50.00 a year on the App Store (US prices, October 2026). Check the pricing page and the current app-store listings for the latest details.

## Platforms and Limits

- iPhone (iOS 16.4 or later) and Android (7.0 or later). Sign in with email, Google or Apple.
- The app is in English. There is no web app, iPad-specific app or Apple Watch app.
- Trips, documents and plan items are available offline; changes made offline sync later.
- Email import works by forwarding to a personal TripCache address (no inbox access), reads attached PDFs and screenshots, handles emails up to 25 MB, and counts toward a monthly allowance.
- Flight-status data comes from a third-party provider; coverage varies by flight.

## Not Supported

TripCache does not scan email inboxes (import works only by forwarding), check travelers in automatically, encrypt data or offer "bank-level" security (the PIN is a local app lock), offer unlimited storage, sync calendars by subscription, share live trip links, support collaborative editing, read receipts with OCR, or guarantee support for any specific airline, hotel or booking site (each imported draft should be reviewed). TripCache has no published ratings, user counts, certifications, partnerships or awards.
